body: REFUSAL PROVED BEFORE COMPILING THE LAW AMENDMENT, in the required order. I added error-shape-independent assertions to the three concrete PopulationSuite scenarios and ran only alignJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.align.PopulationSuite; laws was not compiled. Result 21/21, exit 0. Exact observations: (1) PopulationAggregate.of(view, Vector(foreign-proof)) isLeft when the node ids are known but content fingerprint differs; (2) PopulationAggregate.of(view, Vector(own, foreign)) isLeft for a mixed population; (3) PopulationAggregate.of(view, Vector(subject carrying a different recall from its proof)) isLeft. Each then separately matches the new typed case and exact identities, so refusal and diagnostic shape are distinct assertions. This demonstrates the production safety behavior is unchanged; the three 0-pass law failures are stale error-shape matchers, not accepted mismatches. I will now compile/test the laws amendment that asserts the exact typed subject/proof/aggregate and subject/proof/supplied-recall payloads.
